rca of the issue: Original bug: logout() did not clear the persisted demoAccess flag in localStorage, so the login page's password field (rendered only when demoAccess=false) stayed hidden and login skipped the password check. Fix: on logout, remove the localStorage key and reset the demoAccess state, restoring the fresh-visit gate. Verified in code and via UI + localStorage inspection.
